svg.title: Sunset Lookout Utila: owner-inspired conditional off-plot path
svg.desc: Walking floor grades pass a 9.9 percent cap, but assumed rock/tree clearance tests fail. Exterior ground and permission are unknown. Ten flights of eight risers and twenty level landings are allocated. Left-side labels mark every three metres gained from the lower arrival, which is defined as base zero. Heights are relative, not sea-level elevations.

g.text: Your wider landscape route: a conditional off-plot test
Designed walking grades below 10%; stairs separate. Exterior terrain and use rights are NOT established.
Outer strip reaches about 6.0 m beyond
Actual rock outlines / roots not measured
Floor down to 3.9 m below known model
And 0.6 m above it inside parcel
Clear width 1.8 m; outer strip 2.0 m
Route approximately interprets the owner’s red sketch; cropped eastern return and upper connection are design hypotheses.
Large green % labels: walking grade. Brown arrows: steps per flight. Blue landings: 0%. Small tags: distance in metres.
Grade passes do not establish land rights, real rock clearances, excavation/support feasibility or child safety. Up is uphill, not north.
Heights are relative to the lower path arrival (0 m). Gold guides mark route-floor milestones, not terrain contours.
+3 m labels are vertical climb from the lower arrival; stair crossings are interpolated alignment levels, not individual tread levels.
